scope: S014 existing evidence only; one prelocked fixed exposure contrast, plus inventory and algebraic decomposition

findings.finding: Both C0056 and C0057 have 138 actual entries, only 40 in A evaluation/use population and 98 outside it
limits: Not a claim that EX031/32 training used only A dates
Earlier broad/horizon studies exist
Not a filtered account or annual attribution

findings.finding: C0056 2024 entry-day contribution -13.41pp; 2025 entry-day +22.10pp but other holding-day -29.70pp; different decision duties
limits: Contribution denominator is year-opening equity
No claim losses are foreseeable or avoidable
Not one universal downside-filter solution

findings.finding: EX034/35 already show post-sale participation changes action ordering; fixed endpoints and policy duties matter
limits: E6 and E9 are not new untested ideas
C0011 and C0056 policies differ
Tail and all-history-selection limits retained

findings.finding: Prelocked past-six-session extra-opportunity group has lower A9 but also lower O9; proposed higher subsequent-participation-value explanation is not supported
limits: All history seen; 145 nodes/59 overlapping clusters
Common-strata population and weights differ from raw
Only 25/2000 joint bootstrap draws retain all fixed common strata
No new signal or causal attribution
Do not reverse direction, scan windows or transfer to C0056

findings.finding: 2023/24 saved option model MSE worsens; 2025/26 improves; direct option and old coefficient reallocation both affect saved decisions
limits: Symmetric MSE allocation is algebra, not causal ablation or independent information
No term-alone trading rule evaluated
Not evidence all ETF/options data are ineffective

findings.finding: No-earlier-forecast-found in 19 periods is not prior market ignorance; five point-like forecasts do not identify surprise-outside-an-interval effect
limits: Other channels not exhausted
Three source periods remain unknown
Not proof financial information has no value

routing.dependency: Original C0056 stage-three entry, exit, reservation and execution contract
routing.question: Do existing components and labels cover the actual full entry/holding/reparticipation decisions, and both downside damage and missed upside?
routing.distinct_from_prior: Quantify actual-policy use/evaluation coverage and changed-label duty gaps before choosing a new information claim; not rerun broad factors on a renamed queue
routing.deliverable_next: One explicit uncovered decision duty, its strongest competing explanation, minimal distinguishing design and budget; or evidence-based recommendation to stop
routing.secondary: Retain option line only after decision duty and distinct incremental question are established
